$comment: Reviewed licence exceptions for scripts/ci/check-client-licenses.mjs. An override names one third-party package at one exact version; a new version needs a new review. licenseFile is the evidence the reviewer read (advisory; the gate does not open it). An override or a first-party scope never rescues a GPL, AGPL, LGPL, EPL or SSPL licence. firstPartyScopes (architect ruling P2-R29): a package in the scope passes with the scope's licence at any version, but only when its lockfile 'resolved' URL starts with the registry prefix; a package in the scope resolved from anywhere else, or with no resolved URL, fails whatever its licence. @io-kit/* version bumps need no entry here. shippedDevDependencies lists devDependencies that are copied into the build output; they and their closure are checked like production packages. When data-navigator@3.0.0 (an MIT LICENSE file, no license field) is adopted, add its entry here in the same PR.
